Package controllers

package controllers
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BaseController
    Shared controller class used for common UI functionality, this includes login/signup and navigation
    GameController
    Controller for the main game logic and interactions which handles all user clicks, guesses, zooms and pans and the success popup when getting the answer correct.
    LandingPageController
    Controller for the landing page of the applications.
    LoginController
    Controller for the login page Handles the user login, navigation back to the landing page, and nav to the sign-up page Inherits from BaseController to access common UI elements like email and password fields.
    SignUpController
    Sign up controller Handles the signup and navigation on the sign up page Inherits from BaseController to access common UI elements like email and password fields.
    SuccessPopupController
    A controller for the success popup that allows handles playing again, exiting out, accessing passport page and stats on the game.
